- Times include starting Python. Arelle runs load the EBA 4.2 taxonomy packages as part of reading, and count the filing indicators as facts.
- dpm-xbrl checks the filing rules while it reads, so its filing-rule rows are read times; eba-xbridge runs `validate(eba=True)`.
- eba-xbridge cannot read xBRL-CSV; its time on the 7.3-million-fact package is its `validate(eba=True)`.
- dpm-xbrl converts with the EBA 4.2 taxonomy packages (`write_xbrl_csv(..., taxonomy_packages=...)`), including opening them.

Sample reports read (109 files: the EBA samples and three synthetic packages):

- dpm-xbrl: 109/109
- eba-xbridge: loaded 52/52 XML, validated 109/109
